top_signals.title: Vinted taps DHL’s Germany collection points to expand second-hand market
top_signals.summary:
Sellers of used products on Vinted’s app in Germany can now exchange products with buyers through DHL parcel and post collection points, including locker systems, the companies announced.

The post Vinted taps DHL’s Germany collection points to expand second-hand market appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Visa Beats Estimates, Takes $563 Million Charge on Job Cuts
top_signals.summary: Visa reported a fiscal third-quarter profit that beat Wall Street estimates hours after the world’s biggest payments network told staff that it will eliminate roughly 2,600 jobs. Bloomberg Intelligence's Diksha Gera joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
